# Sleipnir

> Code-first multi-transport RPC framework for .NET 8/10/11: C# controller classes are the contract (no .proto), every method is served over REST, WebSocket, SSE (events) and SignalR, and typed TS/JS/C#/Python clients are generated from a committed contract file. NuGet: Sleipnir.Server, Sleipnir.Client, Sleipnir.Server.Codegen, Sleipnir.Generator. npm: sleipnir-client, sleipnir-codegen.

Start with AGENT_GUIDE.md: packages and versions, minimal setup, error handling, the codegen loop, events, pitfalls, and which reference answers which question. The references below are the source of truth; read only the one you need.

## Start here

- [AGENT_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/HolgerTheHuck/Sleipnir/blob/main/AGENT_GUIDE.md): the 5-minute map for agents building an app with Sleipnir
- [GETTING_STARTED.md](https://github.com/HolgerTheHuck/Sleipnir/blob/main/GETTING_STARTED.md): first server, first call, first generated client
- [README_DETAILS.md](https://github.com/HolgerTheHuck/Sleipnir/blob/main/README_DETAILS.md): every feature with examples
